title: Reconciliation with God
definition: Reconciliation with God is God's act of bringing sinners who were His enemies into peace and fellowship with Himself through Christ.
summary: Reconciliation with God is the restoration of peace between holy God and sinners through Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ makes peace by His cross and brings believers near to God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Reconciliation addresses the broken relationship caused by sin. Through the cross, God removes hostility, makes peace, and brings believers near. This doctrine is deeply personal: salvation is not only a changed status but restored communion with God.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because sin alienates people from God even when life appears religious. Reconciliation announces that enemies can become welcomed children and worshipers. It also shapes the Church into a people who pursue peace because they have received peace.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Draw near to God as one welcomed through Christ. Refuse to treat prayer and worship as distant formalities. Seek reconciliation with others where possible, reflecting the peace you have received.
